recognize_zh: 低倍免疫組織化學染色中，淋巴結內可見大量緊密排列、背靠背的圓形結節，結節呈深棕色陽性、結節間較淡，呈現擁擠濾泡的結構；未標示抗體，若為 BCL2，濾泡陽性支持濾泡性淋巴瘤，但本圖染色背景偏棕、對比有限。
features: Low-power view of numerous closely packed, round to oval nodules (follicles)
Nodules show darker brown immunostaining than the internodular areas
Follicles are crowded and back-to-back with little intervening tissue
Nodules are relatively uniform in size and shape
Diffuse light brown background staining limits contrast; antibody not specified
describe_en: Low-power immunohistochemical stain of a lymph node shows effacement of architecture by numerous closely packed, relatively uniform follicles that stain more intensely than the internodular areas. The specific antibody is not indicated, and diffuse background staining reduces contrast; cytologic detail cannot be assessed. If this represents BCL2, positivity within germinal center-like nodules supports neoplastic follicles, as reactive germinal centers are BCL2-negative. Findings are consistent with a follicular growth pattern in keeping with follicular lymphoma.

ddx.vs: Reactive follicles vary in size and shape, show mantle zones and polarization, and have BCL2-negative germinal centers.
NLPHL shows large vague nodules of small B cells with scattered CD20+ LP cells that are BCL2 negative.
Nodular MCL is cyclin D1 and SOX11 positive and CD10 negative, whereas follicular lymphoma is CD10+/BCL6+.

ddx.dx: Marginal zone lymphoma with follicular colonization
ddx.vs: Colonized follicles are surrounded by pale marginal zone cells that are CD10 and BCL6 negative, with residual follicular dendritic meshworks.
